post.summary: Transfer a participant's place to another principal
post.description: Requires calls.write and an Idempotency-Key. The same Call continues (TRANSFERRING): the target's endpoints are rung with TRANSFER offers; when the target joins with a media path the transferring participant is retired and the Call returns to CONNECTED. If the target declines, does not answer or cannot join, the transfer FAILS and the Call returns to its pre-transfer state (CONNECTED or HELD) when the remaining parties still have a media path.

200.description: The command's result (or the recorded response of an identical earlier command).

get.summary: Active commercial plan versions (entitlement profiles; no prices)
get.description: Active commercial plan versions (entitlement profiles; no prices).

post.description: Scope conversations.create; the acting principal becomes the owner. Context class and security profile are checked against the persisted effective policy: the profile defaults to the context's default (PRIVATE_E2EE where eligible), MANAGED only where the application policy allows it, never a silent fallback (E2EE_NOT_AVAILABLE when encryption cannot be established). DIRECT conversations are deduplicated per principal pair and profile; a live context reference is unique. Idempotency-Key replays the stored response (200).

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

201.description: Created (201) or an existing / replayed conversation (200).

get.description: Keyset-paginated (limit 1-100, cursor). orderBy=createdAt (default): newest first. orderBy=lastActivity: the inbox order, latest application message first (Section 13, MSG-007); a cursor is valid only with the orderBy that produced it. With CF-Acting-Principal: that principal's conversations with ACTIVE membership (messages.read), each carrying its inbox summary (last activity, last visible message preview metadata, unread and mention counts); without: the environment's conversations (conversations.manage), without summaries.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal's own conversations (scope messages.read; for PATCH: the owner). Without it: the application's administration view (scope conversations.manage).

get.description: One conversation of the credential's environment; for a member principal (messages.read) or the administration (conversations.manage). Others: NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal's own conversations (scope messages.read; for PATCH: the owner). Without it: the application's administration view (scope conversations.manage).

patch.description: Scope conversations.manage. Server-authoritative lifecycle transitions (ACTIVE, LOCKED, CLOSED, ARCHIVED, DELETED; EXPIRED by the server only) and expiry, with optimistic concurrency (expectedVersion). Expiry is evaluated first. A security profile change is refused (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal's own conversations (scope messages.read; for PATCH: the owner). Without it: the application's administration view (scope conversations.manage).

post.description: Scope attachments.write, acting member. Policy-checked (attachments enabled for the environment and context, kind, size, quotas reserved atomically). Returns a signed upload bound to size / digest / type. PRIVATE_E2EE: the client encrypts BEFORE upload; file name, media type and durations are refused (they travel inside MLS). 200: the same pending upload reused.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

200.description: Idempotent replay of an earlier identical request.

get.description: Scope attachments.read. The uploader, or a member through a message within their history window.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

get.description: Scope attachments.read. A proxied, bounded read re-authorized on every request (immediate revocation). Responds with the stored bytes, Content-Disposition: attachment, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Cache-Control: no-store and a sandboxing CSP.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

post.description: Scope attachments.read. Authorization re-checked now (membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY); a removed member gets no fresh grant.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

post.description: Scope attachments.write, the uploader. Re-verifies the stored object's size and SHA-256; MANAGED: content-type security and the self-hosted scan (fail closed: VERIFYING while the scanner is unavailable, QUARANTINED when infected). Idempotent.

post.description: Provision a reservation that holds the number (202: PROVISIONING until the provider's acquisition is proven; poll GET). In order: the reservation is the caller's and still holds the number (HELD and unexpired, or taken over by an assignment of the scope); eligibility is RE-EVALUATED (KYC, risk, limits, capabilities, the serving provider's requirements) — a pre-eligibility hold never provisions; every capability is supported; the provider hold is read back (HOLD_LOST otherwise). One transaction then records the scoped idempotency key, the acquisition, the number's PROVISIONING and the durable PROVISION command. A provider timeout after possible execution is reconciled from read-back, never resent; a refusal FAILS the acquisition (retryable). PROVISIONED is not an active customer number. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

The eligibility decision must be of the requested class and, for an individual class, about the owner (ELIGIBILITY_SUBJECT_MISMATCH), and is RE-EVALUATED. Targets are bounded by the class (TARGET_NOT_PERMITTED). One transaction records the key, the assignment (REQUESTED → PENDING_ELIGIBILITY → ELIGIBLE → RESERVED), the hold take-over, the routing profile and the optional pool membership. Requires scope `numbers.assign`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

Creates a Communication Context (version 1): the consumer-neutral authority for WHY (opaque externalContextReference), WHO (participants: principal ids or opaque ContactReference ids), in which DIRECTION, over which CHANNEL, during which window and under which bounded policy parties may communicate. Requires privacy.contexts.write and an Idempotency-Key. Referenced principals must be active principals of the credential's own application environment. Scope comes only from the credential; status, version, authorization results, telephone numbers, providers and relay numbers are never inputs. One context per external reference in an application environment. 503 PRIVACY_RELAY_DISABLED while the feature is disabled.

patch.description: Typed, versioned configuration update (participant replacement / reassignment on the SAME context, channels, directions, validity, bounded policy, allowed strategies) — never a status patch or an arbitrary merge patch. Requires privacy.contexts.write, expectedVersion (409 CONTEXT_VERSION_CONFLICT when stale; a stale write can never restore removed authority) and an Idempotency-Key. The version increments exactly once; removed participants lose authority the moment the update commits, in every relay session; active calls of removed participants are terminated when the policy says so (enforcement.status APPLIED or PENDING, never claimed early).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Repeating it is a safe idempotent answer.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Creates a Privacy Relay Session (NOT a call: one session may authorize many call attempts during its window) under a relay strategy. Requires privacy.sessions.write and an Idempotency-Key. Participants, channels, directions, validity and strategy may only NARROW the context; anything broader is refused (PARTICIPANT_NOT_AUTHORIZED, CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED, DIRECTION_NOT_ALLOWED, STRATEGY_NOT_ALLOWED, VALIDITY_NOT_CONTAINED). get.description: Requires privacy.evidence.read (knowing a session id is never enough). Calling verifies with Privacy Relay, in the credential's scope, that the session exists for the caller — a session of another scope is exactly 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND — then returns evidence from its OWN Call records: canonical timestamps, final state, normalized terminal reason and failure category, Calling's authoritative connected duration (never requestedAt -> endedAt), per-participant connected time, attempts, route class and the Privacy Relay decision ids. NO_ANSWER comes from the canonical Call record (independent of push delivery). Never a telephone number, masked number, Contact Vault material, provider / carrier identifier, provider payload or credential. 200.description: The subscription and its new signing secret.

calling.Call.description: One call with participants, session summaries and durations. Durations of open connections are measured up to durationsAsOf (the call's end for terminal calls). connectedDurationMs runs from the first CONNECTED to the end (null if never connected). invitations are the Call's ring offers (one per target endpoint and ring round); transfers its application transfers.

calling.CallCounterpart.description: Another participant of the Call (internal display identity only).

calling.CallHistoryEnterprise.description: Safe enterprise labels of an enterprise Call: the dialed internal extension (a short code or alias, never a telephone number), its label, the routing phase / outcome and the current ring group / queue labels.

calling.CallHistoryEntry.description: A Call as it appears in one principal's history.

durationMs.description: From CONNECTED to the end of the Call; null while it lasts or if it never connected.

recordingAvailable.description: A READY call recording exists (metadata and audio through the authorized, audited recording routes).

calling.CallHistoryList.description: One page of a principal's call history, newest Call first (createdAt DESC, callId DESC).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.CallHistoryVoicemail.description: The voicemail message left on the Call — present only for an owner of its mailbox. Its audio is reached through the authorized, audited voicemail routes (never a URL here).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.CallParticipant.description: A logical participant. displayName is presentation metadata only and never identifies anyone. connectedDurationMs is the union of the participant's session connection intervals (concurrent devices are not double counted).

calling.CallParticipation.description: The principal's own part in the Call (one per logical participant, whatever its devices).

answeredAt.description: When the participant (any device) answered; for the initiator, when the Call was answered.

calling.CallSession.description: Summary of one device / network participation of a participant (its media / signaling identity is not exposed). connectionCount is the number of connection intervals opened (1 + reconnects). endpointId is the application endpoint the session runs on; mediaAccess is NONE until the server authorizes the session's media (initiator, or the participant's single winning device), REVOKED for ever after removal; mediaAdmittedAt is when the provider confirmed an admitted connection; removedAt is set when the session was removed.

calling.ErrorCode.description: Stable public error codes of the Calling service.

calling.ErrorEnvelope.description: Error response body. Messages are fixed, safe strings; authentication failures are uniform.

calling.HistoryDestinationType.description: Enterprise destinations a listing may be narrowed to.

calling.HistoryDirection.description: Direction of a Call relative to the principal whose history it is.

calling.ParticipantOutcome.description: The outcome of a Call for ONE logical participant, derived from Call evidence only (participant, ring offers on every device, session connection intervals, the Call's state) — never from a push, a realtime signal or a client acknowledgement, and never stored as a flag. OUTBOUND: ANSWERED, NOT_ANSWERED (ended unanswered), IN_PROGRESS. INBOUND, first match wins: ANSWERED (an offer accepted on any of the participant's devices, or a session connected), DECLINED, ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE (the offers were won by another participant of the same answer group — a ring-group or queue colleague), RINGING (an offer is live), MISSED (offered on at least one device and every offer ended unanswered), NOT_REACHED (never offered, Call over), IN_PROGRESS. A losing device of a participant that answered is never a second (missed) entry.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallCore.description: Fields of every Call representation (HTTP API, call-control results). Provider-independent: no provider or carrier identifiers, execution bindings, media identities, telephone numbers or protected contact data.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version: 1 at creation, +1 per state transition.

endedAt.description: When the call reached a terminal state.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallEndpointKi.description: Neutral kind of a registered application endpoint (a device / client instance of a principal).

calling.calling.common.v1.CallEndpointPr.description: Presence hint used to order ringing; never an authorization.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallFailureCat.description: Normalized failure category. Provider error codes never become categories.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallInvitation.description: Why a ring offer exists: the Call itself, or an application transfer to a new target.
State of a ring offer to one endpoint. PENDING and RINGING are live; every other state is terminal and final (an offer is never revived). The server owns expiry.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallKind.description: Neutral media kind of a Call. No consumer business meaning.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallMediaAcces.description: A session's media authority: NONE until the server authorizes it (initiator, or the single winning device of a participant), AUTHORIZED while it may hold media credentials, REVOKED for ever after removal or the end of the session.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallMediaCapab.description: Media capabilities the server authorizes for one session's media connection. Derived from server state (call kind, participant permissions, hold); never chosen by the client. There is no administrative, recording, room-creation or room-listing capability.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallState.description: Canonical business state of a Call. Terminal: ENDED, DECLINED, BUSY, NO_ANSWER, FAILED, CANCELLED.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallSummary.description: A call as listed and as returned by call-control commands.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallTerminalRe.description: How a Call reached its terminal state. ENDED records its completion evidence; every other terminal state has the reason of the same name.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallTransferFa.description: Why a transfer did not complete. A failed transfer returns the Call to its pre-transfer state when the remaining parties still have a media path.

calling.calling.common.v1.CallTransferSt.description: Application transfer lifecycle, kept out of the Call state (the Call is TRANSFERRING while a transfer is active).

calling.calling.common.v1.SafeEventData.description: Bounded, flat, privacy-safe event data: at most 32 snake_case keys that never name secrets, credentials, contact data or provider / carrier identifiers; values are booleans, numbers, safe text or short lists of safe text.

calling.calling.common.v1.SafeText.description: Bounded text without control characters that never looks like a telephone number (+<digit>) or a tel: / sip: URI.

calling.calling.control.v1.AcceptResult.description: The offer was accepted: this endpoint's device won its participant's answer (single winner), the participant's other offers became ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE, and sessionId is the winning session that may now request media credentials. callAnswered is true when this acceptance moved the Call to ANSWERED.

reason.description: Why the action is unavailable: the credential lacks calls.write, the Call's state does not allow it, or the configured media provider cannot enforce it.

calling.calling.control.v1.AvailableActi.description: Server-derived actions currently valid for a Call and the authenticated credential. The client never computes them from local state.

calling.calling.control.v1.CallInvitatio.description: A ring offer of a Call to one endpoint of one target participant. Status and terminal reason always agree: an offer that expired, was cancelled or was answered elsewhere can never be accepted, and a live offer has neither.

calling.calling.control.v1.CallTransfer.description: An application transfer of a Call (kept out of the Call state).

calling.calling.control.v1.CommandReques.description: Body of cancel, end, hold, resume and session removal: the expected Call version and nothing else (no state, reason or permission can be sent).

expectedVersion.description: The Call version the command was decided on (optimistic concurrency). A different current version is refused with 409 STALE_CALL_VERSION.

calling.calling.control.v1.ControlResult.description: Result of cancel, end, hold and resume: the Call after the command. END answers with ENDING until provider cleanup is confirmed, or ENDED once it is.

calling.calling.control.v1.CreateCallReq.description: Body of POST /v1/calls. The initiator calls from one of its registered ACTIVE endpoints; every target is a principal of the same application environment (resolved inside the credential's scope; an unknown or foreign principal is 404). One target is a one-to-one call, several targets a group call (at most the configured participant limit, 16 by default, including the initiator). The server decides authorization, routing, ringing and media; nothing of that can be sent. Part E: instead of principal targets, ONE protected public-network contact (targetContactReference, an opaque ContactReference issued by Privacy Relay — never a telephone number) under a Privacy Relay Session: an APP_TO_PSTN call executed by Telephony after Privacy Relay (PUBLIC_RELAY), the Routing Engine, the telecom switches and a durable spend reservation all allow it (403 PUBLIC_ROUTE_DENIED / 503 PUBLIC_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE / 429 TELECOM_SPEND_LIMIT_EXCEEDED otherwise). The caller identity is selected server-side; no request field can set it. Part E §47 callback relay: callbackRequested with the requester's own verified protected contact (initiatorContactReference) and the callee's (targetContactReference) under a Privacy Relay Session, without an endpoint: Telephony calls the requester first and the callee only after the first leg answered; both legs are bridged in one Call (two legs, two usage facts).

initiatorEndpointId.description: The initiator's registered ACTIVE endpoint. Required for application and APP_TO_PSTN calls; absent for a callback relay.

callbackRequested.description: The requester asks to be called back on its own protected contact and bridged to the callee (Part E §47). A request, not a route: Privacy Relay and the Routing Engine decide whether CALLBACK_RELAY is allowed (403 PUBLIC_ROUTE_DENIED otherwise).

initiatorContactReference.description: The requester's own verified protected contact (callback relay only).

targetContactReference.description: A protected contact (opaque ContactReference). Requires privacyRelaySessionId; exclusive with targetPrincipalIds.

privacyRelaySessionId.description: Optional Privacy Relay Session (cfmeet.privacy-relay.session). The call becomes a PROTECTED call: Calling asks Privacy Relay for current authority (PRIVACY_RELAY_V1) before anything rings, records the decision and fails closed (503 PRIVACY_AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE) when no answer can be obtained; it never falls back to APP_DIRECT_V1. VOICE only. A transfer of a protected call re-authorizes the new target.

targetExtension.description: Part F: an enterprise extension number (an internal short code, never a telephone number) resolved in the credential's scope and routed by enterprise configuration over ENTERPRISE_INTERNAL (no public leg, no spend). Requires enterprise.calls.use and initiatorEndpointId; excludes every other target. An unknown number is 404; a policy refusal 403 CALL_NOT_AUTHORIZED; enterprise calling disabled 422 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.

presentedNumberResourceId.description: Part IV L: a Digital Communications Number (CF Meet Number Resource id — never a telephone number) to present as the caller identity of a targetContactReference call instead of the session's relay identity. Numbering must hold it ACTIVE for the credential's scope with usable outbound voice, and the initiator must be entitled to present it: the owner of a personal / professional number, or an ACTIVE enterprise principal reached through an organization number's voice target (organizational scope alone never suffices). 403 PUBLIC_ROUTE_DENIED otherwise; 503 PUBLIC_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE while Numbering is unreachable. No other identity is ever substituted.

calling.calling.control.v1.CreateCallRes.description: Response of POST /v1/calls (201; replays return the same body with Idempotent-Replayed: true). The call is normally RINGING with one live offer per eligible target endpoint; it can still be ROUTING while the media resource is being prepared (the reconciler resumes it), or already FAILED (ROUTING when no target has an eligible endpoint, MEDIA when the resource could not be prepared in time). Part F: an enterprise Call (targetExtension) additionally carries its enterprise context; while it waits in a queue or IVR it may list only the initiator.

enterprise.description: Present for an enterprise Call only: its safe enterprise context.

calling.calling.control.v1.DeclineResult.description: The offer was declined. Only this endpoint's offer ends; the Call ends as DECLINED only when every live offer of every pending target has been declined.

calling.calling.control.v1.EmptyRequest.description: A command without parameters (media credentials): an empty object or no body. The server derives every capability; any field is refused.

calling.calling.control.v1.Endpoint.description: A registered application endpoint of a principal. Presence is a routing hint only.

endpointKey.description: Opaque client-chosen device key, unique per principal while ACTIVE. Never a telephone number or a tel: / sip: URI.

calling.calling.control.v1.EndpointCapab.description: Media the endpoint can handle. Every application call needs audio: endpoints without audio are never rung; an audio-only endpoint is rung for VIDEO calls too and simply publishes no camera.

calling.calling.control.v1.InvitationCom.description: Body of POST /v1/calls/{call_id}/accept|decline (backend answering on behalf of one of the target's endpoints).

expectedVersion.description: The Call version the command was decided on (optimistic concurrency). A different current version is refused with 409 STALE_CALL_VERSION.

calling.calling.control.v1.MediaCredenti.description: A short-lived join credential for one authorized session's connection to the Call's media resource: the connection URL, the opaque token, its expiry and the capabilities the connection receives once admitted. Room names, provider identifiers, provider keys and administrative grants are never part of it. A losing device, a removed session, an expired offer or a terminal Call never receives one.

url.description: Calling's media connection gateway URL (wss:// in production), never the media server itself.

token.description: Opaque join credential bound to this session's media identity, its current media generation and the Call's media resource, sealed by Calling's media edge: the media server does not accept it directly, and the gateway admits it only while that generation of the session holds media access. It carries no administrative grant.

calling.calling.control.v1.RecoveredInvi.description: An offer of the endpoint as recovered after a reconnect, with the authoritative Call state. actionable is true only for a RINGING, unexpired offer of a Call that can still be answered.
Response of GET /v1/calling/invitations (signaling credential): the endpoint's live and recently finished offers.

calling.calling.control.v1.RegisterEndpo.description: Body of POST /v1/calling/endpoints. Registering the same key for the same principal again refreshes it (200).

endpointKey.description: Opaque client-chosen device key, unique per principal while ACTIVE. Never a telephone number or a tel: / sip: URI.

oneOf.description: Opaque reference to a push target held by the application (no push token).

calling.calling.control.v1.SessionRemova.description: Result of removing one session: its media access is revoked and the provider connection removed (or queued for enforcement).

calling.calling.control.v1.SignalingCred.description: A short-lived Call Signaling Credential for one endpoint, handed to the device by the application backend. It authenticates only the endpoint's own signaling operations and never a platform API operation; the platform API credential never reaches the device.
Body of POST /v1/calling/signaling-credentials: one ACTIVE endpoint of one principal.

calling.calling.control.v1.TransferReque.description: Body of POST /v1/calls/{call_id}/transfer (Idempotency-Key required): the participant who hands its place over, and the principal who takes it. The same Call continues; no second Call is created. Part F: exactly one target — a principal, an enterprise extension or a typed enterprise destination; an enterprise Call's policy must permit transfers (else 403).

expectedVersion.description: The Call version the command was decided on (optimistic concurrency). A different current version is refused with 409 STALE_CALL_VERSION.

targetExtension.description: Part F: an enterprise extension number resolved in the credential's scope (requires enterprise.calls.use). It is followed to ONE principal: a member directly, a ring group's first eligible member, a queue's first available agent, a schedule's current route.

targetDestination.description: Part F: a typed enterprise destination (ENTERPRISE_MEMBER, PRINCIPAL, EXTENSION, RING_GROUP, QUEUE or SCHEDULE of the same scope; requires enterprise.calls.use), resolved like targetExtension. A PUBLIC_CONTACT is refused: 403 when the enterprise policy forbids public forwarding, 422 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE otherwise (public transfer of an established call is not offered by this deployment).

calling.calling.control.v1.TransferResul.description: Result of POST /v1/calls/{call_id}/transfer: the same Call (TRANSFERRING) and the transfer now ringing its target.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.ActivateIv.description: Body of PUT /v1/enterprise/ivr-flows/{ivr_flow_id}/activation: the published version NEW Calls run (Calls already in the IVR keep theirs). Its destinations are re-validated.

expectedVersion.description: The version the change was decided on. A different current version is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT and changes nothing.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.AdminCapab.description: Organization-level administrative capabilities (second key after the credential's enterprise scopes). MANAGE_PUBLIC_FORWARDING and MANAGE_RECORDING are granted by a CF Meet operator only.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.AgentStatu.description: ACTIVE agents receive offers; PAUSED agents stay members but receive none.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.AuditRecor.description: Durable evidence of one administrative change (append-only). details holds bounded safe values only.

actorKind.description: Who the change is attributed to.

actorPrincipalId.description: The acting human member's principal (in this scope) when a first-party organization request forwarded by the Meeting Service made the change; null for API credentials, the operator CLI and Calling workers.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.BindSipDev.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/sip-devices: binds an operator-minted opaque device reference to an ACTIVE principal of the scope. Never a SIP URI, address, credential or number.

displayLabel.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.BuiltinPro.description: The controlled built-in prompt catalog. The media plane plays its own copy (Telephony maps it to edge-local audio; an application client to its own asset). Never a URL, path, file name or synthesized text. Each prompt has a nominal length the media plane's audio must fit (WELCOME, MENU, NO_INPUT, GOODBYE 2 s; PLEASE_HOLD, TRANSFERRING, CLOSED 3 s; INVALID_OPTION 4 s; VOICEMAIL_GREETING 6 s; BEEP 1 s): a menu's input timer starts after the prompts it queued, and a HANGUP node's prompt plays for its nominal length before the platform ends the Call.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

timezone.description: An IANA time-zone identifier (e.g. Africa/Lagos, Europe/London). Never a raw UTC offset: DST and historical offset changes come from the IANA database.

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.BusinessHo.description: A deterministic evaluation: (schedule version, instant) -> OPEN / CLOSED, the local date / time / UTC offset it used and the route it selects.

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

timezone.description: An IANA time-zone identifier (e.g. Africa/Lagos, Europe/London). Never a raw UTC offset: DST and historical offset changes come from the IANA database.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CallPolicy.description: A page of policies (keyset, creation order).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CallRecord.description: A recording of ONE canonical Call. Integrity metadata only: never an object-storage key, a bucket, a stored URL, a telephone number or a provider identity (media through media-access).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the audio.

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CallRecord.description: The recordings of a Call (oldest first).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.ConsentPar.description: Who must consent: NONE, every participant, or every participant other than the one requesting the recording (a system / administrator request: everyone).

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

timezone.description: An IANA time-zone identifier (e.g. Africa/Lagos, Europe/London). Never a raw UTC offset: DST and historical offset changes come from the IANA database.

openDestination.description: The OPEN route: an ENTERPRISE_MEMBER, PRINCIPAL, EXTENSION, RING_GROUP, QUEUE or IVR of the same scope.

closedDestination.description: The CLOSED route: an ENTERPRISE_MEMBER, PRINCIPAL, EXTENSION, RING_GROUP, QUEUE, IVR, VOICEMAIL or (where the enterprise policy permits public forwarding) a PUBLIC_CONTACT of the same scope.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreateExte.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/extensions. The number must match the governing policy's format, be unused and unambiguous (numeric extensions are never prefixes of each other) in the namespace (the credential's scope).

displayLabel.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreateForw.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/forwarding-rules. At most one ACTIVE rule per principal and condition; an ALWAYS rule that would close a cycle of principals is refused (routing also stops loops with its visited set and hop budget).

destination.description: An ENTERPRISE_MEMBER, PRINCIPAL (not the owner), EXTENSION, RING_GROUP, QUEUE, IVR, VOICEMAIL or PUBLIC_CONTACT of the same scope. Never a number.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).
Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreatePubl.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/public-contacts: registers a PROTECTED public destination for forwarding / closed routes — an opaque Privacy Relay ContactReference and the Privacy Relay Session whose authority covers it. Never a telephone number. Requires an enterprise policy that permits public forwarding.

label.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreateQueu.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/queues. offerTimeoutSeconds is the ring time of one offer to one agent and is at most maxWaitSeconds.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

overflow.description: Where a Call goes when the queue is full or its maximum wait elapses: an EXTENSION, RING_GROUP, another QUEUE, IVR or VOICEMAIL of the same scope (never the queue itself). Without one a full queue ends the Call BUSY and an elapsed wait NO_ANSWER.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreateReco.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/recording-policies. A recording policy is SEPARATE from the right to call, enterprise membership, Privacy Relay authorization and any meeting recording policy.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

noticeRequired.description: Every participant must be notified (the server issues the notice: a realtime notice to application endpoints, a tone at the edge for SIP legs) before capture starts.

jurisdictionRef.description: Opaque reference to the compliance configuration this policy implements (e.g. NG-NDPA-2023/v2). Authoritative input from compliance / legal — the platform never infers recording law from a country. Never a telephone number.

retentionDays.description: Days a READY recording is kept before the retention worker deletes it (audited).

maxRecordingSeconds.description: Maximum recording length in seconds (the recording then stops: MAX_DURATION).

isDefault.description: The scope's effective policy (one ACTIVE default).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreateRing.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/ring-groups. fallback (EXTENSION, QUEUE or VOICEMAIL of the same scope) takes the SAME Call when no member answers.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.CreateVoic.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/voicemail/mailboxes. Requires an enterprise policy permitting voicemail.

displayLabel.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

maxMessageSeconds.description: Maximum message length in seconds; the edge stops capturing at this length.

retentionDays.description: Days a READY message is kept before the retention worker deletes it (audited as the system).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.DayWindow.description: An open window inside one exception date (start before end).

end.description: Local wall-clock time HH:MM (24:00 = end of day).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Department.description: An administrative / routing group of principals.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Department.description: One member: an ACTIVE principal of the same scope (a foreign or unknown principal is 404).
A member's organizational role (grants no scope or capability).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Destinatio.description: A typed destination: an ACTIVE resource of the SAME tenant / application / environment (a foreign or unknown one is 404).

Kinds of enterprise destination. SCHEDULE is a business-hours schedule (its OPEN / CLOSED route). PUBLIC_CONTACT is a registered public contact (an opaque Privacy Relay ContactReference; forwarding and closed-hours routes only), never a telephone number.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.EffectiveP.description: The policy in force for the environment: its ACTIVE default, else the restrictive built-in default (policyId null, version 0).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Enterprise.description: The safe enterprise context of a Call (create result and call history): the dialled extension's number and label as they were when the Call was placed (a snapshot that survives renumbering and offboarding), the policy version relied on, the routing phase, the current destination kind and the enterprise outcome. No member, device, provider or contact data.

extensionLabel.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Enterprise.description: The IVR state of a Call (caller view): what the caller hears (recent built-in prompts) and may press (allowed keys) while a menu waits. Never the keys pressed; selectedBranch is a node id. ACTIVE without awaitingInput and with an inputDeadline: a HANGUP prompt is playing and the Call ends at the deadline.

oneOf.description: Node id (1-32 lower-case letters, digits, underscores).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Enterprise.description: The queue state of a queued enterprise Call (caller view): the queue, the entry state and the authoritative position (null once the entry finished).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.EvaluateBu.description: Body of POST /v1/enterprise/business-hours/{business_hours_id}/evaluation: the instant to evaluate (now when absent).

displayLabel.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.ExtensionF.description: Extension number format of the namespace.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.ExtensionN.description: An internal short code — never a public telephone number: 2-6 digits, or a lower-case word (letters, digits, '-') starting with a letter. Matched case-insensitively.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.Forwarding.description: ALWAYS: before ringing. BUSY: every ring offer to the principal was declined. NO_ANSWER: the offers expired. UNAVAILABLE: the principal has no eligible endpoint.

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.HoursExcep.description: An exception date (holiday, special hours). It governs its whole local date: the date's weekly windows, and a previous day's window crossing midnight, do not apply on it. No global holiday calendar is used.
CLOSED: closed the whole local date. CUSTOM_HOURS: open only in its windows.

name.description: Bounded display name (no control characters, never a telephone number).

version.description: Optimistic version of the resource (1 at creation, +1 per change).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.IvrFlowVer.description: The most recent versions of a flow (newest first).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.IvrGraph.description: A declarative IVR graph: 1-32 uniquely named nodes, every node reachable from startNode, every reference to an existing node or an ACTIVE destination of the same scope, no loop without caller input. Validated on publish.

startNode.description: Node id (1-32 lower-case letters, digits, underscores).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.IvrHangupN.description: Optionally play a prompt; the IVR ends the Call (outcome COMPLETED_IN_IVR).

id.description: Node id (1-32 lower-case letters, digits, underscores).

calling.calling.enterprise.v1.IvrInputRe.description: Body of POST /v1/calls/{call_id}/ivr/input: one key of the RTC caller (the Call's initiator endpoint only). Used once, never stored or logged.
Whether the IVR took the key (false: the Call does not wait for one).

gateway.platform-developer.common.v1.Gat.description: GET /internal/v1/gateway/context: the canonical Platform Access ids of the caller's application environment, as Platform Access re-validated them from the API Gateway's signed delegated context.

gateway.platform-developer.gateway.commo.description: Public error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). An unknown route is NOT_FOUND (default deny); messages never echo input, credentials or upstream text.

gateway.platform.common.v1.ApplicationEn.description: Kind of a customer application environment (Part B section 7).

gateway.platform.common.v1.CorrelationId.description: Server-generated identifier that stays stable across every hop of one causal operation.

gateway.platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

allowedDomains.description: DOMAIN_RESTRICTED / EXTERNAL_ONLY: verified email domains treated as internal.

appointmentRef.description:
HEALTHCARE_APPOINTMENT: optional appointment reference forwarded to the
appointment authority (which alone decides).

requireVerifiedRevocation.description:
Fail closed when an authenticated session's revocation cannot be verified
(always on for HEALTHCARE and HIGH_SECURITY security profiles).

guestSessionTtlSecs.description: Lifetime of guest / external participant sessions.

requireExternalContext.description: External participants must present an external authorization context.

waitingRoomForced.description: Waiting room applies even when the space says OFF (hosts stay exempt).

email.description: Matched only against verified account emails.

userId.description: Registered CF Meet user. Exactly one of `userId` / `email`.

meetings.AgendaItem.description: One occurrence on the caller's agenda.

conferenceId.description:
The conference id; null for a recurring occurrence beyond the materialization
horizon (it becomes a conference later, under the same `occurrenceKey`).

materialized.description: False for an occurrence computed from the recurrence rule (not yet materialized).

occurrenceKey.description: Stable occurrence identity within the meeting space (unchanged by materialization).

meetings.AgendaRelation.description: Why an occurrence is on the caller's agenda.

items.description: Ordered by scheduled start, then meeting space, then occurrence key.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

meetings.AgendaSpace.description: Meeting-space fields an agenda entry may show.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the meeting: show times in this zone and in the viewer's zone.

title.description: Omitted for HEALTHCARE / HIGH_SECURITY spaces unless the caller manages the space.

answer.description: Optional written answer (omit when answered live).

meetings.ArtifactView.description:
Public artefact projection: never exposes storage keys, provider references,
internal diagnostics or signed URLs.

deletionPending.description: Deletion requested; no new access is issued.

failureCode.description: Public-safe failure category (internal diagnostics are never returned).

breakoutIds.description: RANDOM / BALANCED: target rooms (default: every CREATED/OPEN room).

onlyUnassigned.description: Only distribute participants without an assignment (default true).

unassigned.description: Eligible participants left unassigned (all rooms at capacity).

meetings.AttendanceReport.description:
Signed, short-lived, single-object read access (never persisted).
Conference attendance (Part J attendance contract). Attendance time is merged from
participant-session intervals, so multi-device presence is never double counted.

enhanced.description: Enhanced semantic audit (join, artefact access, consent, admin access).

credentialRefreshRequired.description:
Request a fresh credential for the new context
(`POST /api/v2/conferences/{id}/media-credential`).

meetings.BreakoutRecordingPolicy.description: Breakout recording metadata only — recording itself is Part G.

participantIds.description: Assigned participant ids — only for roles that manage breakouts.

skipped.description: In a state that does not allow this transition.

unchanged.description: Already in the requested state (idempotent retry).

meetings.ChatPolicyUpdateRequest.description: Chat-only subset of the collaboration policy.

countdownSeconds.description: Grace period before participants return (0 = immediate, max 600).

meetings.CollaborationPolicy.description: Complete effective collaboration policy of a conference.

aiNotice.description: Show an AI-processing notice before join (no AI runs in Part F).

audioLocked.description: Conference-wide microphone lock for every role without `participant.mute`.

mainChatVisibleInBreakouts.description: Whether participants inside a breakout still see (read-only) main chat.

requiredConsents.description: Consents an attendee must grant before admission (pre-join contract).

videoLocked.description: Conference-wide camera lock for every role without `participant.mute`.

meetings.CollaborationPolicyPatch.description: Sparse override. Unknown fields are rejected.

collaborationVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency: the `collaborationVersion` the client last read.

meetings.CollaborationStateResponse.description: Canonical collaboration snapshot (REST recovery after realtime gaps).

eventSequence.description: Realtime cursor this snapshot is at least as new as.

changed.description: False when the request was an idempotent no-op (e.g. already LIVE).

recordingState.description:
Part G: recording indicator (`OFF` / `REQUESTED` / `RECORDING` / `STOPPING`) —
the authoritative recovery source after a reconnect.

meetings.ConferenceSummary.description: Minimal conference info included in space responses.

active.description: The processing is currently active in this conference.

required.description: Affirmative consent is required before this processing runs.

recordingNotice.description: Recording notice is always shown while capture is active.

count.description: Number of automatically numbered rooms ("Room N").

conferenceId.description: Restrict the invitation to one occurrence.

expiresInHours.description: Default 168 (7 days); capped by server policy.

sendEmail.description:
Blueprint Section 11: also email the invitation link to `inviteeEmail` (required
with this flag). The result is reported in `emailDelivery`. Default false.

token.description: Raw bearer token. Returned exactly once; only its hash is stored.

organizationId.description: Must be an organization the caller verifiably belongs to.

passcode.description: Plaintext passcode; only a bcrypt hash is stored and it is never returned.

internalNote.description: Administrative note — stored, never shown to the participant.

meetings.EmailDelivery.description: What happened to a requested invitation email.

message.description: Safe, human-readable message (never SQL, provider bodies, secrets or paths).

requestId.description: Server-generated correlation ID (also in the `x-request-id` response header).

meetings.ErrorCode.description: Stable, semantic public error codes for the Phase 2 meeting domain (spec v1.1 §5).

meetings.ErrorEnvelope.description: OpenAPI description of the public error envelope.

resyncRequired.description: True when the cursor cannot be served: refetch `canonical` and resume from `cursor`.

sourceArtifactId.description: READY transcript artefact of this conference.

consents.description: Part F: explicit consents granted before admission (see the pre-join contract).

displayName.description: Presentation name only — never identity. Required for guests.

externalContext.description:
Opaque context forwarded to a server-side access authority (e.g. a HealthNet
appointment token). Never treated as proof by the meeting service itself.

previousSessionId.description: Reconnect: supersede this earlier session of the same participant.

participantToken.description:
Server-issued participant credential for non-registered actors (send as
`X-Participant-Token`). Returned only when newly issued.

meetings.JoinRealtimeInfo.description:
Realtime subscription and recovery resources for a joined (or waiting) participant.
Paths are relative to the API origin; authorization is re-evaluated on every call.

conferencePath.description: Canonical conference state — the primary recovery resource.

enabled.description: Whether the conference WebSocket stream is available (`FEATURE_CONFERENCE_REALTIME_ENABLED`).

eventsPath.description: REST replay of missed events (`?after=<sequence>`; present when `enabled`).

participantPath.description: The caller's own participant state (admission decision fallback when polling).

participantSessionId.description: Close one session; omitted = close all of the caller's sessions.

meetings.MeetingProfile.description: The specialized mode a space resolves to.

nextCursor.description:
Present only on paginated requests (`limit` or `cursor` sent) when another page
exists: pass it back as `cursor`.
Pass as `before` to fetch older messages; absent at the end.

toBreakoutId.description: Target breakout; null = back to the main conference.

organizationRole.description:
Once the Organizations Service is authoritative: the caller's full role (OWNER,
ADMIN, MANAGER or MEMBER); `role` then shows MANAGER as MEMBER.

retainPreviousOwner.description: Keep the previous owner as a HOST member (default true).

denialMessage.description: User-visible denial message (internal notes are never exposed).

correct.description: Option ids (choice/ranking) or rating value as string. Stripped from public views.

Quiz: correct option indexes (choice), the exact order (ranking) or `[value]`
(rating). Never returned before the results state allows it.

options.description: Option labels (choice / ranking). Ids `o1…oN` are assigned by the server.

idempotentReplay.description: true when this request was a retry of an already-recorded ballot.

score.description:
Quiz score, only where the results state already allows it (AFTER_VOTE,
non-anonymous).

averageScore.description: Quiz: average score and maximum (aggregate only).

myScore.description: The caller's own score (non-anonymous quiz, results visible).

externalAuthorization.description: Decided by an external authority (e.g. a healthcare appointment).

granted.description: Already granted by the caller's participant (rejoin).

required.description: Must be granted (join request `consents`) before admission.

meetings.PreJoinDevices.description: Client-side device contract. The backend never needs device ids for authorization.

backgroundEffects.description: Background blur / replacement run client-side only.

deviceIdentifiersCollected.description: Device ids, labels and fingerprints are never sent or stored.

speakerSelection.description: Speaker selection depends on the platform (setSinkId support).

identityBearing.description: Always false: a display name never selects identity, role or participant.

suggested.description: Suggested name (profile name for registered users).

joinable.description: Media join is possible right now (LIVE).

title.description: Hidden for sensitive (healthcare / high-security) meetings until authorized.

meetings.ProcessingLocation.description: Where processing may run. Ordered from most to least restrictive.

meetings.ProfilePolicy.description: The complete effective profile policy of a space / conference.

changes.description: Sparse override (validated against the profile schema; unknown keys rejected).

profilePolicyVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency (`profilePolicyVersion` from the last read).

meetings.ProviderEnforcement.description: Provider enforcement state for operations whose media effect is Part E.

sinkDropped.description: Samples the telemetry sink could not take (meeting unaffected).

batchId.description: Client batch id (idempotency for retries; 1–64 chars).

participantSessionId.description:
Optional: one of the caller's own active sessions (resolved server-side
otherwise). Another participant's session is rejected.

providerRegion.description: Provider edge the client connected to (sanitized; operations-only).

averagePositions.description: Ranking: option id → average position (1 = first).

correct.description: Quiz: correct answer, once the results state allows it.

ratingDistribution.description: Rating: value → count, and the average.

texts.description: Text answers (managers only; never attributed for anonymous polls).

delivered.description: Transient: false when the realtime fanout was unavailable (nothing is stored).

sequence.description: Gap-free per-conference sequence (commit order) — the replay cursor.

cursor.description: Current conference event sequence (start cursor for a fresh subscriber).

websocketPath.description: WebSocket path relative to the API origin.

retentionDays.description: Days a READY recording is kept before the retention worker deletes it.

originalStartAt.description: The occurrence's original start (as generated by the series), any distance ahead.

scheduledEndAt.description: RESCHEDULE only; defaults to the series duration.

appliedToConferenceId.description: Set when the occurrence was already materialized and has been updated.

originalStartLocal.description: Original wall-clock start in the series timezone (exception key).

admissionToken.description:
Opaque admission token (shown once; only its hash is stored). Absent for an
idempotent repeat.

conferenceId.description: Register for one occurrence (optional; otherwise the whole meeting series).

customFields.description: Only keys approved by the profile policy are accepted (string values).

scheduledEndAt.description:
New end. Omitted: the occurrence keeps its duration (a start-only occurrence stays
start-only). At most 24 hours after the start.

scheduledStartAt.description: New start; more than 5 minutes in the past is rejected.

version.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the conference `version` last read.

matchedBy.description: How the identifier matched: V2_ID, V2_CODE, LEGACY_ID or LEGACY_CODE.

clampedFields.description: Override fields that a ceiling clamped back (visible to administrators).

misconfigured.description: A stored layer failed validation → restrictive fallback is in force.

version.description: Optional optimistic version of the participant.

externalRoleMapping.description: External role token (e.g. `DOCTOR`) → generic meeting role. Never OWNER.

meetings.RolePolicy.description: Controlled per-space / organization overrides of POLICY cells only.

overrides.description: role → permission key → allowed. Only POLICY cells may be overridden.

meetings.ScreenSharePolicy.description: Who may publish a screen share (on top of the `screenshare.publish` role grant).

announcement.description: Host-only announcement to the main room (`chat.moderate`).

breakoutId.description: Breakout chat of this room (must be the sender's current breakout).

startLocal.description: First occurrence, wall-clock time in the meeting space timezone.

meetings.StageProfile.description: Large-audience architecture: a small interactive stage, a subscribe-only audience.

maxStageParticipants.description: Participants that may publish (every role above VIEWER). 0 = not limited.

viewerCapacity.description: Operational viewer capacity (informational; enforced by space capacity).

meetings.StartRecordingRequest.description:
`POST /recordings` body. The client never selects provider ids, storage buckets
or keys.

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key (repeats return the same recording).

sourceRecordingId.description: POST_MEETING: the READY recording to transcribe.

idempotencyKey.description:
Client-chosen retry key: a retry with the same key is acknowledged
idempotently instead of failing as a duplicate ballot.

meetings.TrackKind.description: Media track kinds the business layer reasons about.

nextAfter.description: Cursor for the next page (`after` = last sequence).

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version the client last read.

meetings.WithdrawalMode.description: What a consent withdrawal does (policy-driven, never one universal rule).

retroactiveDeletion.description: Previously retained artefacts are not deleted by a withdrawal.

meetings.Workspace.description: One workspace context of the caller.

organizationStatus.description: ACTIVE or SUSPENDED (a suspended organization grants nothing). ORGANIZATION only.

provisioningState.description:
NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, READY or FAILED, from the Organizations Service;
null for PERSONAL and when the legacy directory answers (no provisioning there).

role.description:
The caller's role (OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER, MEMBER or GUEST; the legacy directory knows
OWNER, ADMIN and MEMBER). ORGANIZATION only.

meetings.WorkspaceAuthority.description:
Which store answered: the meeting-service organization directory
(`ORGANIZATIONS_AUTHORITY_MODE` legacy / shadow) or the Organizations Service
(authoritative).

capabilities.description: Every capability of the vocabulary with its decision.

evaluatedAt.description: When the answer was computed (it is never cached server-side).

personalCommunicationsCapabilities.description:
PERSONAL only: the Communications Hub read that owns personal communications
capabilities (`/api/v2/communications/me/capabilities`).

policyRevision.description: Organization policy revision the answer was computed with (Organizations Service).

meetings.WorkspaceCapabilityReason.description: Why a capability is (not) granted in a workspace.

meetings.WorkspaceCapabilitySummary.description: A small summary of what the caller can do in a workspace.

canAdminister.description: Organization administration: profile, member management or policies.

canCreateMeetings.description: Meetings can be created in this context.

meetings.WorkspaceFeatures.description:
Features the workspace context does not disable. Owner services still apply their
own policy (stricter wins) and re-verify every request.

items.description: PERSONAL first, then organizations ordered by id.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

role.description: BOT_SERVICE only for BOT_OR_SERVICE principals (BOT_SERVICE_REQUIRES_BOT_PRINCIPAL); bots are never ADMIN / MODERATOR (BOT_CANNOT_ADMINISTER).

invite.description: §35: invite instead of adding. The principal becomes INVITED (no history, no events, no sends) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept); invitations expire after 7 days and count toward the member limit.

cfMeetId.description: Personal CF Meet ID resolved privately through Communications under the authenticated actor and scope. Exactly one recipient identifier is allowed. Rotation invalidates the old public ID; existing canonical conversations remain unchanged.

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

smsBridgeEligible.description: Requires MANAGED among allowedProfiles; SMS is never end-to-end encrypted.

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request — the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Applicatio.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

derivatives.description: Server-made derivatives (metadata reads only; empty for PRIVATE_E2EE).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Attachment.description: An attachment's authorized metadata and lifecycle. Bytes live in protected object storage under a server-generated key.

status.description: QUOTA_DEFERRED: the environment's storage budget has no room for the thumbnail. No object is stored or charged; the original attachment is unaffected; the derivative is retried later or when the attachment policy changes (errorCode STORAGE_BUDGET).

size.description: The stored object's actual bytes (THUMBNAIL), charged to the environment's storage budget alongside the original.

metadata.description: INSPECTION only: the measured facts (null for THUMBNAIL and until READY).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Attachment.description: A server-made derivative of a MANAGED attachment: a re-encoded PNG thumbnail of an image without the original's metadata (THUMBNAIL), or the measured container, duration and dimensions of an image, voice note or video (INSPECTION, no object). Never produced for PRIVATE_E2EE attachments, whose thumbnails the sending client encrypts itself.

residualAccessSeconds.description: A grant issued before a revocation stays usable at most this long; GET .../content re-checks authorization on every request.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Attachment.description: A short-lived signed read of one object forcing Content-Disposition: attachment and the stored content type. Issued only after authorization (current membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY).

mediaType.description: MANAGED: required, in the kind's allow-list. PRIVATE_E2EE: omit (or application/octet-stream).

deviceId.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the uploading device (the acting principal's).

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Backup.description: Metadata of an opaque backup object. keyId and clientBackupId come from the object's public header; the server cannot decrypt the object.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.BackupInte.description: An upload intent for one client-encrypted backup object (Appendix I.3). The client encrypts with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key or content.

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.ClientToke.description: A short-lived Messaging Client Access Token (compact JWS, EdDSA, typ cfmeet-mcat+jwt) bound to tenant, application, environment, principal, device and session. Device-direct use only: POST /v1/realtime/tickets.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.CommitRequ.description: An MLS Commit created in the group's current epoch. removedDeviceIds is the committer's attestation of the leaves it removes; while removals are pending it must cover them all.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.ContextCla.description: Generic context classes; a product's order, trip, consultation or case is only an opaque ContextRef.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

members.description: The first 100 ACTIVE members (owner, administrators, then members); page through GET /v1/conversations/{id}/members for the rest (membersTruncated).

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false — no read receipts in this conversation; null — the environment policy decides.

title.description: Section 13: display title of a MANAGED conversation (always null for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose name belongs inside the MLS group).

avatarRef.description: Section 13: opaque avatar reference of a MANAGED conversation (for example an attachment id the client resolves); never a URL the server fetches.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Conversati.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

data.description: camelCase payload; message events carry the message's CURRENT representation (a deleted message replays as a tombstone).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Conversati.description: A durable conversation event (derived from committed state, replayable by its per-conversation eventSequence). Every durable event names its tenant, application and environment (§117).

Section 13 (MSG-007): the inbox summary of a conversation for the acting member, present in GET /v1/conversations answers that have an acting principal. Left conversations are not listed (only ACTIVE memberships are); a tombstoned last message carries its lifecycle and no content.

lastActivityAt.description: The latest application message (or the creation time); the key of orderBy=lastActivity.

unreadCount.description: Active application messages from others after the member's read cursor, inside its history window, not hidden for it.

mentionCount.description: Unread messages that mention the member (MANAGED mentions; always 0 for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose mentions stay inside the ciphertext).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Conversati.description: Preview metadata of the last application message visible to the member (its history window and delete-for-me markers honoured).

previewText.description: MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the first 140 characters of the text. Always null for PRIVATE_E2EE (the server holds no plaintext and never returns ciphertext here) and for tombstones.

oneOf.description: Opaque; valid only with the same orderBy.

managedDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Regulated contexts: creating a MANAGED conversation requires acknowledging that the server can read its content (refused otherwise with MANAGED_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED).

expiryGraceSeconds.description: §38: requires an expiring conversation. Past expiresAt the conversation refuses new messages (CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE / EXPIRED) but stays readable and extendable for this many seconds before it becomes EXPIRED.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited.

predecessorConversationId.description: Appendix G: create a deliberate SUCCESSOR of this conversation (the only way to move to another security profile). The caller must be an ACTIVE OWNER / ADMIN of it; same context class (DIRECT: the same two principals); never a context-bound conversation (SUCCESSOR_CONTEXT_BOUND); one successor each (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS). No content and no members are copied.

profileChangeDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Required (true) when the successor's security profile differs from its predecessor's; refused otherwise with SECURITY_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED / PROFILE_CHANGE_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED. Clients show the change (e.g. end-to-end encrypted to server-readable) before acknowledging.

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false turns read receipts off for this conversation (never on where the environment policy has them off).

counterpartCfMeetId.description: Personal CF Meet ID resolved privately through Communications under the authenticated actor and scope. Exactly one recipient identifier is allowed. Rotation invalidates the old public ID; existing canonical conversations remain unchanged.

title.description: Section 13: display title (MANAGED only; PRIVATE_E2EE refuses it with CONTENT_REJECTED / DISPLAY_METADATA_MANAGED_ONLY).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.CreateConv.description: A tenant / application / environment is never part of a request: it comes from the authenticated credential.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.CreateSmsB.description: Bridge a MANAGED conversation to one external party by SMS. The number is passed to the SMS Gateway once and never stored by Messaging. A PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is never bridged (E2EE_CONVERSATION_NOT_BRIDGEABLE).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.DeletionRe.description: Legal holds win: held items are preserved and counted (PARTIALLY_HELD).

signaturePublicKey.description: base64url Ed25519 MLS signature PUBLIC key (32 bytes).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Device.description: A Messaging device: PUBLIC key material only (never a private key).

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

expectedEditCount.description: Optimistic version check: the editCount the editor last saw. If another edit committed first the request is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT (reason EDITED_CONCURRENTLY). Omitted: last writer wins.

smsBridgeEligible.description: A MANAGED conversation of this context may be bridged to SMS (default: whenever MANAGED is allowed; never for an E2EE-only context).

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request — the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

messages.description: Message features (platform policy version 4). Replies are always supported; a tenant may turn threads off (replies are kept without a thread root), reactions or pins.

deliveryReceipts.description: Other members learn when a message was DELIVERED to a recipient (messaging.delivery-cursor.updated / delivery-cursor.updated events).

revisionHistoryVisible.description: Members may read the kept revisions of edited MANAGED messages. Revisions are always kept (exports and legal holds include them).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.EffectiveP.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

syncRequired.description: The requested position is older than the retained event window: resynchronize messages by sequence.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.HistoryTra.description: A device-to-device history transfer. Messaging relays an opaque sealed history between two ACTIVE devices of one principal; it holds no key that opens it (no recovery key, no escrow) and deletes the sealed bytes on completion, cancellation, revocation or expiry.

transferPublicKey.description: base64url X25519 HPKE public key (32 bytes) generated by the TARGET device for this transfer only.

expiresAt.description: At most one hour from now (whole seconds are signed).

requestSignature.description: Ed25519 signature by the TARGET device key over packages/messaging-crypto history_transfer::request_signing_input.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.HistoryTra.description: A new device's request for the history its existing device holds (ADR 0052 AD-07).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Invitation.description: The acting principal's open (unexpired) invitations to ACTIVE conversations, newest first.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.LegalHold.description: A legal / compliance hold: held items are never purged or deleted. For PRIVATE_E2EE it preserves ciphertext and metadata only; it never creates a decryption capability.

durationMs.description: Measured from the bytes (null: the container records none).

durationMatchesDeclared.description: Declared vs measured within max(1 s, 5 %); null when either is absent.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.MediaInspe.description: What the server measured in a READY MANAGED attachment's bytes (never inferred for PRIVATE_E2EE ciphertext).

authoritySource.description: How the membership came to be: an administrator or the application backend (API), an accepted invitation, or the meeting integration.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

cryptographicRemoval.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the server-side removal is authorization only; a member's MLS commit removing the devices completes the cryptographic exclusion.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.MemberRole.description: §30: OWNER (the owner), ADMIN, MODERATOR (moderates MEMBER / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE members: remove, ban, unban; no role or ownership administration), MEMBER, READ_ONLY (reads its history window, sends no messages: READ_ONLY_MEMBER), BOT_SERVICE (BOT_OR_SERVICE principals only).

e2ee.description: The protected envelope (Appendix H.1): version, protocol, cipher suite and the scope the client bound into the AAD; the server stores and relays the ciphertext without reading it.

securityProvenance.description: NATIVE: created through Messaging. LEGACY_MANAGED: imported from a legacy chat store (MANAGED only, never presented as end-to-end encrypted).

oneOf.description: LEGACY_MANAGED: the original time at the legacy source.

channel.description: IN_APP, or SMS: arrived through the SMS Bridge (MANAGED only; never end-to-end encrypted).

replyToMessageId.description: The message this one replies to (same conversation, within the sender's history window).

threadRootId.description: The root of the reply thread (the first message replied to).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Message.description: A message. Content (ciphertext or MANAGED text) only while ACTIVE. e2ee for PRIVATE_E2EE rows, managed for MANAGED rows; the acceptance digest binds the server sequence and id to the ciphertext (cfmeet-messaging-acceptance:v2).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.MessageLif.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.MessageRev.description: The kept prior versions of a MANAGED message, oldest first (revision n = the text after n edits). Visible to members only when editing.revisionHistoryVisible; empty for a deleted message.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Moderation.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.PermalinkR.description: A permalink is never authority: resolution checks current membership; a non-member and an unknown id are the same NOT_FOUND.

expiresAt.description: §49: optional pin expiry (in the future). An expired pin is no longer listed nor counted toward the limit; pinning again renews it.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.PinRequest.description: Optional body of PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/pins/{messageId}; an empty body pins without expiry.

shareReadReceipts.description: Appendix K: whether this principal's read position is shared with other members (its own sessions always follow it).

pushDeliveryConfigured.description: false: no push adapter / credentials for this platform in this deployment; jobs end NOT_CONFIGURED (never reported delivered).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.RealtimeTi.description: Single-use, seconds-long WebSocket ticket, presented as a Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry (never in the URL).

keyPackage.description: base64url of the registration KeyPackage (RFC 9420 MLSMessage, wire format mls_key_package).

registrationBinding.description: The exact RFC 9420 application_id leaf extension the registration KeyPackage must carry.

credentialIdentity.description: The exact BasicCredential identity of every KeyPackage of the device.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.Registrati.description: A single-use registration challenge with a server-assigned device id.

messaging.messaging.common.v1.ReportDeta.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.ReportRece.description: What the reporter learns: that the report was received. The reported principal is never told who reported.

disclosure.description: PRIVATE_E2EE only and optional: what the reporter's own device decrypted, disclosed voluntarily (sealed at rest; presented as unverifiable).

sealedHistory.description: base64url of the sealed history: HPKE (RFC 9180) ciphertext to the transfer key, signed by the SOURCE device (history_transfer::seal_history).

messaging.messaging.common.v1.SearchResu.description: Server search covers MANAGED conversations only; PRIVATE_E2EE conversations are searched on devices (LOCAL_SEARCH_ONLY).
